text: Auth product returns verified checking/savings account and routing numbers to initiate ACH, wire, or equivalent payments
quote: Auth allows you to request a user's checking, savings, or cash management account and routing number, making it easy for you to initiate credits or debits via ACH, wire transfer, or equivalent international networks.

text: Balance product provides real-time account balance data, commonly used for sufficient-funds checks before payment
quote: Balance is Plaid's product for receiving real-time balance information. This data is commonly used to tell if an account has sufficient funds before using it as a funding source for a payment transaction

text: Identity product verifies a user's phone, email, mailing address, and name using data on file at their bank
quote: Plaid's Identity product helps you verify users' identities by accessing information on file with their financial institution. Using Identity, you can access a user's phone number, email address, mailing address, and name.

text: Transactions product retrieves up to 24 months of transaction history and can be kept current via webhooks
quote: Retrieve up to 24 months of transaction data and stay up-to-date with webhooks

text: Plaid Link is a client-side widget users interact with to connect their bank accounts to your app via the API
quote: Plaid Link is the client-side component that your users will interact with in order to link their accounts to Plaid and allow you to access their accounts via the Plaid API.

text: European Payments suite lets users make real-time bank payments without manually entering account details
quote: Plaid's European Payments suite enables your users to make real-time payments without manually entering their account details or leaving your app.

text: European Payments covers verification, risk management, and money movement across 18 European markets via one integration

text: Sandbox is a free, fully-featured environment supporting all API and Link functionality, with unlimited test Items
quote: The Plaid Sandbox is a free and fully-featured environment for application development and testing. All Plaid functionality of both the Plaid API and Plaid Link is supported in the Sandbox environment.

text: Sandbox-only API endpoint lets developers programmatically create test Items for any institution with test credentials
quote: you can also create Items in Sandbox via the API, using a special Sandbox-only endpoint, /sandbox/public_token/create. This endpoint allows you to generate a public_token for an arbitrary institution ID, initial products, and test credentia

text: Plaid sends webhooks to notify apps of changes to linked Items or the status of asynchronous processes
quote: Plaid sends webhooks to programmatically inform you about changes to Plaid Items or the status of asynchronous processes.

text: Dashboard MCP server gives production diagnostics, Item debugging, Link conversion data, and usage metrics via remote MCP
quote: The Dashboard MCP server is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid. It provides Production diagnostics and analytics tools, including tools for debugging Items, reviewing Link conversion data, and checking usage metrics.

text: Quickstart app plus self-serve Dashboard API keys let developers spin up a local integration quickly
quote: Let's test out running Plaid locally by cloning the Quickstart app. You'll need API keys, which you can receive by signing up in the Dashboard.

text: Dashboard lets you customize parts of the Link flow with real-time preview and instant publish to production
quote: You can customize parts of Link's flow straight from the Dashboard. You can preview your changes in real time and then publish them instantly once you're ready to go live.
